title: King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard Bring Out Max Weinberg at Forest Hills Stadium
summary: The E Street Band drummer filled in for his son Jay Weinberg, who has become a recurring guest with the band.
body: King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard brought out Max Weinberg as a surprise guest during their Friday (Aug. 21) show at Queens’ Forest Hills Stadium, with the E Street Band drummer filling in for his son, longtime band collaborator Jay Weinberg. Guitarist Joey Walker explained the swap to the crowd mid-set. “In continuing with the tradition that we started over the last year or so, where we get our friend Jay Weinberg to come out and play a song with us — it’d be rude not to. But Jay’s busy, he’s down in Nashville, so Jay made a call: ‘Alright, I’m going to call dad.'” Max Weinberg then joined the band onstage as a second drummer, playing alongside regular drummer Michael Cavanagh on an extended rendition of “Hot Water.” The elder Weinberg’s cameo continues a running bit between the Australian psych-rock band and Jay Weinberg, the former Slipknot drummer who has guested with King Gizzard periodically since first sitting in during a 2024 Nashville show. He appeared again just a week earlier at the band’s Field of Vision II festival in Colorado, playing on “Hell” and hosting a solo drum clinic. The gue…

title: Dale Morris, Nashville Manager Who Guided Careers of Alabama & Kenny Chesney, Dies at 89
summary: The longtime Nashville manager also represented Martina McBride, Barbara Mandrell andJake Owen.
body: Dale Morris, the legendary Nashville artist manager who helped build the superstar careers of Alabama and Kenny Chesney , has died. He was 89. Morris died peacefully in his sleep Friday night (Aug. 21), his representatives said. A specific cause of death was not provided. Related Gone But Not Forgotten: Musicians We Lost in 2026 Paradigm Adds Kenny Chesney & Old Dominion to Roster Following Acquisition of Morris Higham’s Booking Biz Management in Country Music “He lived a big, bold, beautiful, blessed life, and I’m holding onto that right now,” Clint Higham, president of Morris Higham Management, said in a statement about his mentor and longtime business partner. “It’s the end of an era.” Morris began his career in the music industry as a songwriter, penning Johnny Paycheck’s 1967 single “Don’t Monkey With Another Monkey’s Monkey” before turning his attention to the business side. After launching Dale Morris & Associates, Morris was introduced to the up-and-coming band Alabama in 1979 at The Bowery in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. Under his management, Alabama went on to score 33 No. 1 hits on Billboard ’s Hot Country Songs chart — the most among duos…

title: Janie Bradford, Early Motown Songwriter & ‘Money (That’s What I Want)’ Co-Writer, Dies at 87
summary: She also co-wrote songs recorded by Marvin Gaye, Stevie Wonder and Mary Wells.
body: Early Motown songwriter Janie Bradford Hobbs, who helped pen hits including “Money (That’s What I Want)” and “Too Busy Thinking About My Baby,” has died following an extended illness at a Los Angeles hospital, her family said Saturday (Aug. 22). She was 87. Related Gone But Not Forgotten: Musicians We Lost in 2026 Olivia Rodrigo Drops 'Handmaid's Tale'-Inspired 'Serena Joy' as CD Single at Indie Record Store BigXthaPlug Faces Drug and Gun Charges One Year After Last Arrest Bradford Hobbs was born in Charleston, Missouri, and later moved to Detroit. She was introduced in the late 1950s to Motown founder Berry Gordy by neighbor and singer Jackie Wilson . She joined Motown as a receptionist in 1958 and like many of the company’s employees took part in the creative process that helped make Motown a music industry powerhouse. She and Gordy co-wrote “Money (That’s What I Want).” The song was recorded in 1959 by Barrett Strong and became an early hit. It was covered by The Beatles and also became one of that group’s hits. “Too Busy Thinking About My Baby” first was recorded by The Temptations and later became a hit for Marvin Gaye. body: BigXthaPlug has had another run-in with the law. Exactly one year after his previous arrest on similar charges, the 28-year-old rapper was arrested again in Texas on Friday (Aug. 21). Olivia Rodrigo Drops 'Handmaid's Tale'-Inspired 'Serena Joy' as CD Single at Indie Record Store The Dallas native, whose real name is Xavier Landum, was arrested by the Allen Police Department and booked into Collin County Jail on charges of driving while intoxicated, possession of less than 2 ounces of marijuana and unlawful possession of a firearm, according to Dallas’ KDFW . On Aug. 21, 2025, BigXthaPlug was arrested in North Texas on marijuana and weapon possession charges. He was out on bail for those charges when he was arrested Friday. title: Karol G, Maluma & More Unite for Colombia Earthquake Relief & More Uplifting Moments in Latin Music
summary: Plus, Maná becomes the first Latin act to perform for Apple Music's Rediscovered series, and Elvis Crespo returns to NYC for a free concert.
body: From career milestones to new releases to major announcements and those little important moments,  Billboard  editors highlight  uplifting moments  in Latin music. Here’s what happened in the Latin music world this week. Karol G, Maluma, Grupo Niche, Sebastián Yatra & More Will Join Colombia: Voces por la Vida in Bogotá The Latin music industry is coming together to support communities affected by recent earthquake events. On Sunday (Aug. 23), “Colombia: Voces por la Vida” will bring together artists, promoters, companies and media partners at Bogotá’s Vive Claro Distrito Cultural to raise funds for the country’s rebuilding efforts. Led by Ocesa Colombia’s Luz Angela Castro, the lineup includes Maluma, Kris R, Miguel Bosé, Greeicy, Silvestre Dangond, Eladio Carrión, Draco Rosa, Sebastián Yatra, TIMØ, Pedro Capó, Manuel Turizo, Juan Duque and more, with Karol G joining via livestream through her Con Cora Foundation. More artists are expected to participate. The initiative quickly grew into a collective effort involving Ocesa Colombia, MOVE Concerts, Páramo Presenta, CMN, Villalón Group, Diomar García Eventos and many others. Courtesy of…
